title: Lena and the Garden
author: Rafael Underhill
blurb: Casper Villalobos, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
